d: Short, messy silver hair with choppy bangs frames a youthful, adolescent face with sharp, amber-colored eyes. The slender build is dressed in a long, off-white lab coat worn over a black high-collar shirt and dark shorts, accented by a pale teal ribbon tied at the chest. Accessories include a black fingerless glove on the left hand, a camera hanging around the neck with an ID badge, brown leather dress shoes with dark socks, and a brown buckled strap around the right thigh. The figure is seen holding a stack of books under one arm.
